name: eotc-voice-studio
description: EOTC Voice Studio — Amharic voice-to-video pipeline with Remotion motion graphics on GitHub Actions

scripts.render: npm run prepare && npx remotion render src/index.jsx EOTCVideo output/tiktok_ready.mp4 --props=./render-props.json --log=verbose
scripts.render:fast: npm run prepare && npx remotion render src/index.jsx EOTCVideo output/tiktok_ready.mp4 --props=./render-props.json --concurrency=4 --jpeg-quality=75
scripts.render:ultra: npm run prepare && npx remotion render src/index.jsx EOTCVideo output/tiktok_ready.mp4 --props=./render-props.json --concurrency=1 --jpeg-quality=100 --crf=14

author: EOTC Voice Studio
